poc_summary:
Goal: Validate Dedicated for production support chat + embeddings with predictable latency and isolation.
POC scope: 4-week dedicated cluster in us-east + eu-west shadow cluster, canary rollout on one customer org for support Chatflow.
Traffic plan: start with 5% traffic to Dedicated canary, step to 25% after 48h if error rate <1% and p50/p95 latency targets met.
Fallback plan: automatic failover to Hosted API in same region on error spike; cross-region failover to eu-west mirrored pool if us-east unavailable.
Models: test redwood-v1-13b-quant for cost-sensitive path, and llama3-8b-qlora variant for latency-sensitive short-chat. Auto-route by policy: low-latency routes prefer smaller quantized variant; long-context/rerank use bigger model.
Rollback: instant traffic cut to hosted, then redeploy previous Dedicated instance; postmortem window 2 hours.
Success criteria: p95 latency <= 250ms, error rate <0.5%, embeddings throughput >= 150 req/s, cost per 1k tokens < target band provided in pricing deck.
